req.title: DELETE is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 for subsequent DELETE calls on the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-028 requires DELETE /tasks/{task_id} to be idempotent: the first call returns 204, and every subsequent call on the same task_id returns 404. The test suite covers: (1) positive/STC — full state transition from existing→deleted→404; (2) negative/NEG — deleting a never-existing task_id returns 404 immediately; (3) boundary/BVA — idempotency at the boundary of task_id=1 (lowest pre-loaded id) and task_id=20 (highest); (4) DT — triple-call idempotency to confirm the 404 is stable across N>2 calls; (5) EP — mid-range task_id confirms the same state machine. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to avoid shared state, and assert exact HTTP status codes to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_idempotent_positive_state_transition
preconditions: Task with id=5 exists in the database (pre-loaded seed data)
FastAPI app is running in-process with isolated SQLite DB
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a fresh task (avoids seed-data coupling)
expected: Response body of second DELETE contains detail field
trace: R-TASK-028: system shall respond with HTTP 404 for subsequent DELETE calls on the same task_id
tests.executable:
import os, sys
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_idempotent_positive_state_transition():
    r_create = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Write project report', 'completed': False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()['id']
    r1 = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    body = r2.json()
    assert 'detail' in body
    assert str(task_id) in body['detail']

DELETE task B — expect 204 (task B still exists; confirms A's 404 is not global)

import os, sys
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem4 = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession4 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem4)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem4)

def override_get_db4():
    db = TestingSession4()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db4
client4 = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_idempotent_decision_table_all_branches():
    ra = client4.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Read chapter 5', 'completed': True})
    rb = client4.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Book flight tickets', 'completed': False})
    assert ra.status_code == 201
    assert rb.status_code == 201
    id_a = ra.json()['id']
    id_b = rb.json()['id']
    assert client4.delete(f'/tasks/{id_a}').status_code == 204
    r_a2 = client4.delete(f'/tasks/{id_a}')
    assert r_a2.status_code == 404
    assert str(id_a) in r_a2.json()['detail']
    assert client4.delete(f'/tasks/{id_b}').status_code == 204
    r_b2 = client4.delete(f'/tasks/{id_b}')
    assert r_b2.status_code == 404
    assert str(id_b) in r_b2.json()['detail']

import os, sys
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem5 = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession5 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem5)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem5)

def override_get_db5():
    db = TestingSession5()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db5
client5 = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_idempotent_boundary_high_id_and_get_confirms_gone():
    r_c = client5.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Renew gym membership', 'completed': True})
    assert r_c.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_c.json()['id']
    r_get1 = client5.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_get1.status_code == 200
    assert r_get1.json()['id'] == task_id
    r_del1 = client5.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_del1.status_code == 204
    r_get2 = client5.get(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_get2.status_code == 404
    r_del2 = client5.delete(f'/tasks/{task_id}')
    assert r_del2.status_code == 404
    assert str(task_id) in r_del2.json()['detail']
